summary: Implemented the M01 shared routing entrypoint renderer/writer and made all lane acceptance tests GREEN. Init, update, rules sync, and rules distill now publish one compact index.md/full routing.md pair with security and source state preserved; orient and gdskills catalogue consumers resolve routing.md. Directly affected tests pass 57/57, typecheck passes, and normalized health passes. The shared changed-scope test command remains red only because the concurrently owned M10 tests are still in their pre-implementation RED phase; parent owns the integration rerun.
summary_markdown: M01 is implemented and lane-GREEN. The shared changed-scope gate is temporarily partial due only to concurrent M10 RED tests, documented in `T7-verification.md`.

acceptance.criterion: AC1: M01: init, rules sync, rules distill, update and repeated sequences preserve a short index plus full routing document through a shared writer; enabled module/security flags and user-owned entrypoint blocks are preserved.
acceptance.evidence: T5 lifecycle tests now pass init→sync→sync and init→distill→distill→update→update. The shared writer renders once, publishes routing.md then index.md under a lock, passes enableSecurity, ruleSources and distilled state, and preserves root user markers.

acceptance.criterion: AC2: M01: orient/catalog and related consumers resolve the split entrypoint, regression fixtures assert correct ownership of both documents, failed pair publication is observable and recoverable on rerun without a false success.
acceptance.evidence: Orient preserves the actual compact routing-pointer gate; metaproject-router and generated catalogue resolution point to routing.md. The fault-injection test makes routing.md a directory, observes rejection, removes the obstacle, reruns and verifies the recovered pair.
